-- Ajouter les colonnes Odeuropa à story_elements
ALTER TABLE story_elements 
  ADD COLUMN odeuropa_level VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'olfactory' COMMENT 'Niveau Odeuropa: physical, sensorial, olfactory',
  ADD COLUMN narrative_axis VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Axe narratif: botanique, chimie, rituel, formulation, comparaison',
  ADD COLUMN skos_concept VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Concept SKOS Odeuropa (od:L11, od:L12, od:L13...)',
  ADD COLUMN connects_to_element_id INT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'ID du story_element connecté (Story Connection)',
  ADD COLUMN connection_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Type de connexion: co_occurrence, transformation, contrast, genealogy',
  ADD COLUMN odeuropa_note TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Note narrative Odeuropa enrichie';

-- Ajouter les colonnes Odeuropa à storylines
ALTER TABLE storylines
  ADD COLUMN odeuropa_story_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Type: materially_informed, historically_informed, artistic_translation',
  ADD COLUMN smellscape_description TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Description du smellscape (od:L12 Smell Emission)',
  ADD COLUMN sensory_experience TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Expérience sensorielle (od:L13 Olfactory Experience)',
  ADD COLUMN cross_storyline_ids TEXT DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'IDs des storylines croisés (JSON array)';
